title: Closing Reminder
description: Schedules the Server for auto Shutdown and maintainence
body:
Schedules shutdown for server closing and maintainence

Usage:

```
/shutdown hour(s).Minute(s)
```
- Schedules Shutdown Time 

```
/shutdown cancel
```
- Cancels Scheduled Shutdown

config.yml: shutdown_kick_message = Message that players get when it is kicked
